prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, take it, check its properties, and do specific task; if not visible, move to next area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextArea    /> <Action ID = DoSpecificTask    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = RobotFindAndGrab    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO DoSpecificTask
	END
